name: Projection Accessibility Relation Registry
purpose: Formalize directional accessibility relations between projections without implying equivalence, identity, or reversibility.

accessibility_relations.definition: A directional link where some lost features of projection B can be analytically estimated from projection A.
Only the shared source-relation pointer is accessible; no internal features can be reconstructed.
Accessibility that explicitly carries the conflict metadata of the source neighborhood.
Accessibility limited by the maximum allowable deformation of the projected form.
No directional accessibility is permitted due to loss accumulation or domain conflict.

mandatory_constraints.statement: Accessibility does not imply source equivalence.

governance_rules.rule: Every accessibility relation must specify directionality and reversibility status.
Accessibility between QM-like and GR-like analogs must remain ACCESS_CONFLICT_PRESERVING or lower.

forbidden_claims: Accessibility proves that projection A is projection B.
Mutual accessibility implies full source recovery.
Accessibility paths derive physical interaction constants.
